topNews.text: Drones are Saving Hundreds of Fawns From Mower Deaths in Germany (WATCH)
topNews.excerpt: A Bavarian wildlife rescue organization is using thermal imaging drones to locate and rescue vulnerable fawns hidden in tall meadow grass ahead of the annual mowing season. topNews.text: 370,000 Acres of Rainforest and Granite Peaks Now Protected in French Guiana
topNews.excerpt: As part of new wildlands protection law, the French Government has announced the creation of a new nature reserve in French Guiana spanning 370,000 acres.
